primary_query_support: identical physical query bins for native and weak, all valid times retained
primary_paired_quantity: E_pweak[reference frame]-E_pnative[reference frame] at the same query time, separately by each head and probe
event_summary_query_support: only frozen source intervals, identical in the two trajectories
generated_event_selected_rows: descriptive only; never evidence of phase-readout validity
mandatory_diagnostics: time-constant bias removed, separate from raw signal
negative_controls: uniform probability independent of output event time
selection: all56heads/all8probes; no head/step/window choice from result
phase_validity_decision: assess both steps, every predefined event and null controls; do not infer from only event-selected phase means
